Prerequisites: Greased Lightning class feature

Flourish a flying spin kick, assaulting your target with a powerful torrent of wind. You may declare your next unarmed strike on your turn to be a Tornado Kick as a free action, dealing an additional 1d6 wind damage per Greased Lightning stack to your target on a successful hit. All stacks of Greased Lightning are expended once this attack is resolved (even if you miss).
